// what_i_do

What the work covers.

Schema markup

JSON-LD schema, validated in Google's Rich Results Test.

llms.txt setup

An llms.txt file that points AI tools straight to the key pages and services.

AI crawler readiness

AI-readable content organization, so existing site information is more clearly structured for automated discovery.

Internal linking and on-page SEO

On-page SEO and internal links between related pages, so visitors and search engines move through the site more easily.

Core Web Vitals

Core Web Vitals and page speed checks as part of the technical review.

Search Console and analytics

Basic GA4, GTM, Search Console, and Google Business Profile setups.

What llms.txt can and can't do.

llms.txt is a proposed format, not an official standard, and no AI tool is guaranteed to read it. I set it up as a low-cost extra on top of the basics that come first: crawlable pages, clear structure and valid schema. I don't promise rankings or AI mentions.

How a project runs.

Five steps, the same every time, so you always know what happens next.

  1. 01

    Discover

    A short call or brief to understand your goals, users, platform and deadline.

  2. 02

    Plan

    Scope, task list, time-box and a clear definition of done, agreed before I start.

  3. 03

    Build

    Built on staging or a duplicate page first, with Git backups at every milestone.

  4. 04

    QA

    Mobile, speed, links, forms and tracking checked before anything goes live.

  5. 05

    Launch & support

    Go-live, handoff notes, and optional monthly care so the site stays healthy.

// faq.md

Questions, answered.

Which platforms do you work with?

WordPress (Elementor, Gutenberg, WooCommerce), Shopify, GoHighLevel, Squarespace and Wix, plus custom builds in React / Next.js and automations in n8n.

How long does a project take?

Small fixes usually take 1–3 days. A full website or Shopify store usually takes 2–4 weeks. The timeline is agreed up front, before work starts.

Is my live site safe while you work?

Yes. I work on staging or a duplicate page first, back up with Git, and confirm with you before anything changes on the live site.

What time zone are you in?

I'm based in Mindanao, Philippines (GMT+8) and schedule calls around US, UK and AU working hours. I keep a few hours of overlap with your working day for calls and quick replies.
